row: The Fit Massage Therapist teaches to heal and prevent work-related injuries.  With a focus on strength training, nutrition, and body mechanics for massage therapists, The Fit MT supports massage therapists to move better, eat better, and use their bodies correctly for a long and successful career.  Stay strong and work smart to work as long as you want in the physically demanding field of massage therapy.
